cards.title: Stock-Flow Record
cards.description: Emissions, removals, atmospheric carbon, land sinks, ocean sinks, units, and accounting boundary.

cards.title: Pathway Record
cards.description: Historical, baseline, mitigation, net-zero, overshoot, or negative-emissions pathway assumptions.

cards.title: Sink Record
cards.description: Land uptake, ocean uptake, airborne fraction, impulse response, and carbon-cycle feedback assumptions.

cards.title: Budget Record
cards.description: Carbon budget, temperature goal, probability framing, historical emissions, and remaining allowance.

cards.title: Removal Record
cards.description: Negative-emissions rate, durability, accounting status, feasibility, and permanence.

cards.title: Claim Boundary
cards.description: Teaching, pathway comparison, carbon budgeting, policy analysis, or decision support.
